value.rationale: An exact all-pair Calkin norm is a natural quantitative upgrade to the 2026 commutativity question. It is a structural four-point boundary functional on the disk algebra, handles arbitrarily high-degree and nonpolynomial analytic symbols, and detects interference not encoded in individual monomial commutator values (for \(f=1\), \(g=z+z^4\) the exact value is \(2\sqrt6\)). It provides a sharp computable invariant rather than a routine qualitative zero test or arbitrary finite slice.
